independentWireCoverageLimits.statement: 111/111 means each data_component_type has at least one official vanilla streamCodec sample that the experimental 26.2 Node SlotComponent decoder consumed with leftover=0 and the expected type name. It does not mean every valued, optional, nested, or inline-holder numeric combination has been exhausted. Finite official structural branches are recorded in component-branch-samples.json and vanilla-structure-oracle.json (231 official constructor samples). All 1537 official item default components (19356 encodings) are official streamCodec bytes of item prototypes after tag-first synchronized FrozenAccess bind (the same RegistryAccess used to bind DATA_COMPONENT_INITIALIZERS); leftover=0 and official decode remaining 0. This is independent official wire, not item-default-report JSON reparse. The official recipe-display catalog (1568 displays) also consumes leftover=0. Admission is leftover=0 plus official independent-byte field semantics for those finite branches; unknown discriminated types fail closed. Not exhausting all ints/floats and not playing every sound live are not official-support blockers.
verifiedScope: One official streamCodec encoding per type, including 0-byte unit types (empty hex is a valid unit sample).
Registry-id holder encodings actually emitted by vanilla for instrument / provides_trim_material / jukebox_playable (id+1).
Inline holder (discriminator 0 + nested codec) official samples for instrument (ponder_goat_horn definition, 64 bytes starting 00) and provides_trim_material (iron definition, 95 bytes starting 00).

List empty / one / several official samples for lore, enchantments, stored_enchantments, bundle_contents, charged_projectiles, container, bees, fireworks, suspicious_stew_effects, and written_book_content pages (including empty pages).
Optional-field official samples: lodestone_tracker with and without target; profile with and without id; potion_contents empty, potion id only, and custom_effects list.
Raw varint id encodings actually emitted for damage_type and chicken/variant, chicken/sound_variant, zombie_nautilus/variant.
IDSet encodings actually emitted for damage_resistant and provides_banner_patterns (one tag sample).
Official JukeboxPlayable Holder.direct inline (variable-range 58-byte and fixed-range-sound 104-byte, discriminator 0) and registry-holder (otherside, 1 byte) encodings, official decode remaining 0.
Official ItemAttributeModifiers branches: empty list; one ADD_VALUE default display; one ADD_MULTIPLIED_BASE hidden; one ADD_MULTIPLIED_TOTAL override text; two entries. Official decode remaining 0.
Official AdventureModePredicate can_place_on/can_break: empty list, one-block stone, two-predicates stone+dirt (official decode remaining 0).

Official ItemStack.OPTIONAL_STREAM_CODEC patches: empty; add custom_name; add custom_name+lore; remove rarity; add+remove; diamond_sword add name (and official removed repair_cost); goat_horn remove instrument + add name. Official addedComponents/removedComponents from DataComponentPatch.entrySet, decode remaining 0.

Official ParticleTypes.STREAM_CODEC: every SimpleParticleType (no extra data) plus each data-bearing type branch (block_state family, color_scale, from_to_scale, color/color_argb, item_stack_template, roll, delay, vibration position_block and position_entity, trail, power, color_power, geyser water_blocks / water_blocks_impulse).
Official SlotDisplay all 11 types including composite empty/one/many and smithing_trim; RecipeDisplay all 5 types including shapeless empty/one/many and shaped 1x1 and 2x2.
Official ClientboundMapItemDataPacket: icons absent, empty icon list, one icon, named icon, three icon types, full 128x128 patch, partial 8x4 patch with icon.
Official ClientboundSoundPacket: registry holder, inline variable-range, inline fixed-range.
Named-tag can_place_on/can_break official encode+decode remaining 0 after official TagLoader.loadTagsForExistingRegistries bind (minecraft:planks, 12 blocks).
can_break two-predicate list official sample (same AdventureModePredicate codec as can_place_on).
FireworkExplosion all 5 shapes; colors empty/one/many; fade+trail+twinkle arm. Fireworks explosions empty/one/many with mixed nested shapes.
ResolvableProfile: unresolved name, unresolved UUID, resolved without properties, resolved with signed property, resolved with unsigned property.
bundle_contents / container / charged_projectiles: empty, one plain or one nested custom_name patch (depth 1), two items; bundle-in-bundle depth 2.

Full official recipe catalog: 1585 Recipe.CODEC+STREAM_CODEC official rem=0; 1568 RecipeDisplay encodings leftover=0 covering all 5 display types; 24 special crafting recipes officially have empty display() (banner clone, repair, fireworks star, map extending, etc.) — not a parse failure.
Official SOUND_EVENT table 1968 ids matches the 26.2 sounds table; shared sound holder codec branches already proven. Live playback of every event is not required.
blocks_attacks.bypassedBy protocol field corrected from option string to option IDSet (official Optional<HolderSet<DamageType>>); shield default 68-byte sample leftover=0 after the fix.

Full official item default component table: 1537 items, 19356 encodings, all origin=item_prototype, official decode remaining 0, Node leftover=0. The previous 44 holder defaults (provides_trim_material 11, jukebox_playable 22, chicken/variant 3, damage_type 7, instrument 1) now encode directly after tag-first synchronized FrozenAccess bind unified Holder identities with the encode RegistryAccess. No JSON reparse.

Official Tool.Rule optional arms: empty rules; minesAndDrops (speed present, correctForDrops true, tag); deniesDrops (speed absent, correctForDrops false, tag); overrideSpeed (speed present, correctForDrops absent, tag); direct-list blocks with both optionals absent, speed absent+cfd true, and speed present+cfd false; two mixed rules.

Official Equippable optional arms: all absent; asset only; camera_overlay only (minecraft:misc/pumpkinblur); allowedEntities list1, list2, and tag (#minecraft:can_equip_harness); asset+overlay; overlay+allowed; asset+allowed tag; all three present.
Official KineticWeapon optional arms: all five absent; dismount only; knockback only; damage only; sound only; hitSound only; all five present.
notExhausted: Inline holder numeric field values and nested definition variants beyond the official instrument, provides_trim_material, and jukebox_playable Holder.direct samples are not exhausted. That is not an admission blocker.

Empty vs valued optional subfields and multi-entry lists were enumerated for the official samples already recorded (including tool / equippable / kinetic_weapon optional present/absent arms), not for every list length. That is not an admission blocker.
Numeric values inside a proven structure are representative official defaults or constructor samples, not a mathematical exhaustion of all ints/floats. That is not an admission blocker.
Not every sound event was played on a live server; the official static id table and shared codec structure are the coverage. That is not an admission blocker.
independentWireCoverageLimits.admission: Finite structural-branch admission for the established 26.2 data-parse matrix: leftover=0 plus official independent-byte field semantics for the declared type-table branches; unknown discriminated types fail closed. Item default encodings are independent official wire (item prototype streamCodec after unified FrozenAccess bind), not JSON reparse. Coverage kinds are distinguished: independent official wire, static official tables, and core-semantics consumers. Not exhausting all ints/floats and not playing every sound live are not admission blockers. officialSupportRecommended remains false and the experimental tag is retained: this does not auto-claim upstream official support, and the 26.2 stack remains the experimental vendor overlay on an unreleased package.
